required: maximum two tonal planes per material
strong negative space around arms, legs, weapons and accessories
consistent visual weight with the rest of the roster
forbidden: bloom, lens flare or realistic glow (any glow is a flat solid shape)
jackCheck: Would the silhouette remain recognizable if filled entirely with black?
Could the character be animated using relatively few large shapes?
Is the design readable at thumbnail size?
Are the colors flat and intentionally separated?
Is the character distinctive without relying on elaborate surface details?

shape.tank: wide blocky rectangles and a big shield shape
shape.bruiser: heavy trapezoids, oversized fists and shoulders
shape.fighter: balanced diagonals with one clear weapon line
shape.assassin: sharp triangles, long thin blades, a low coiled posture
shape.caster: flowing diamonds and a bright flat focus shape
shape.blaster: long straight lines and a bold wedge-shaped weapon
shape.controller: hexagons and wide arc gestures with tools hanging off the body
shape.support: soft rounded rectangles with an open palm and a visible kit
shape.enchanter: circles and stars around a charm, instrument or talisman
shape.summoner: one big commanding gesture silhouette with several small, clearly separate minion shapes around it

simplify: FIGURE: about 12 to 15 big shapes in total
OUTLINE: one thin, uniform-weight black line
SHADING: each material is one flat color plus at most one flat darker shadow shape; no shine or soft shading
FACE: minimal; simple geometric eye shapes under one brow line, one nose line, one mouth line; no eyelashes, eye highlights or skin shading
HAIR and FUR: two to four big solid pointed shapes, never strands, braids, curls or texture
FABRIC: large flat planes with straight or sharply angled edges and at most three big creases; no ragged hems, streamers, patterns, trim bands, tassels, stitching, studs or rows of buckles
METAL and GEAR: plain solid shapes in flat grey, black or an assigned color; no engraving
HANDS and FEET: simple blocky shapes
at most ONE repeated graphic symbol on the whole figure
clear negative space between limbs, prop and body
never: photorealism, 3D or CGI, painterly or watercolor texture, detailed anime rendering, airbrushing, gradients, glow or bloom or lens flare (a glow is a flat solid shape), fabric texture, tiny decorations, individual hairs, realistic reflections, generic fantasy concept art
